name: beat-four-and-a-fill
about: docs/BEAT.md's worked example, read by the beat reader (pib_read) and loaded before frame 0; then the play edit. The chain 1 1 1 2: pattern 1 three bars, pattern 2 (the fill) the fourth, pattern 1 again (the chain starts over). Swing 12 moves only the snare on steps 14 and 16 (odd grid steps: ticks 5868 and 6060). Step 15's 70% takes the first draw from seed 1, 270369: 69 is under 70, it fires (5952). The clap plays its sample and is out of the effects (sampled 0100, fxsounds feff); every step entered by keys keeps its pair, so ea and eb are the kick's kept 32768 while a and b are the hand's 30000 and 36000. Effect 2 on steps 13 and 14 moves no trace.
